newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp & Paper, Itochu plan alliance.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp & Paper, Itochu plan alliance.

text.p: Asia Pulp & Paper Co Ltd said Monday it has signed a nonbinding memorandum of understanding with Itochu Corp to establish a strategic alliance.
The partnership, said the company, would be conditioned on the purchase by Itochu of $100 million of mandatory exchangeable preferrence shares to be issued by a finance subsidiary of APP.
Those shares would be exchanged for APP ordinary shares within five years of the purchase date.
APP also said that the partnership would give Itochu the right to nominate one director to its board.
APP said the alliance will help it in areas where Itochu would have complementary strengths, such as raw material procurement, and marketing and distribution in markets not "fully exploited" by APP.
